problem.title: Stop losing money to chaos
problem.subtitle: These three problems silently drain every venue. Afrah fixes them by default.

items.title: Leads slip through WhatsApp
items.problem: Your team forgets to follow up. The lead chooses another venue. You'll never know.
items.solution: Auto-reminders after every call. 3 attempts, then the lead is auto-closed with a reason — no inquiry is forgotten.

items.title: Double bookings on the calendar
items.problem: Two staff confirm the same hall on the same shift. The fight starts at the door.
items.solution: One source of truth. Real-time conflict detection across halls, shifts, and tentative holds.

items.title: Payments lost in spreadsheets
items.problem: InstaPay receipts in WhatsApp. Cash in a notebook. Final payment? No one's sure.
items.solution: Every payment logged with method, date, and proof. Outstanding balance updates live for every booking.

features.title: Built for the way venues actually work
features.subtitle: From the first WhatsApp message to the final payment receipt — one platform, one source of truth.

items.title: Smart Booking Wizard
items.desc: 4-step flow: pick the client, lock the date and shift, choose the package, confirm. Conflicts blocked at step 2.

items.title: Visual Calendar
items.desc: Month, week, and day views. Color-coded by status. See every hall's pipeline at a glance.

items.title: Inquiry Pipeline
items.desc: Track every lead from new → contacted → toured → quoted → converted. Auto-close after 3 silent attempts.

items.title: Egyptian Payments
items.desc: Log InstaPay, Fawry, Vodafone Cash, bank transfers, or cash. Track deposit → 2nd payment → final balance.

items.title: Realtime Notifications
items.desc: When a hold is expiring, a payment is overdue, or a reminder is due — your team knows the second it happens.

items.title: Multi-hall + Packages
items.desc: Configure unlimited halls with capacity and amenities. Build flat-rate or per-person packages.

items.title: Bilingual & RTL
items.desc: Arabic-first interface with full RTL layout. Switch to English in one click. No exceptions, no half measures.

items.title: Roles & Permissions
items.desc: Admin, sales, accountant — each role sees only what they need. Multi-tenant ready from day one.

how.title: Three steps from lead to wedding
how.subtitle: The same path every successful booking takes — automated end to end.

steps.title: Capture the inquiry

faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: If we missed something, send us a message.

items.q: Do I need to be online all the time?
items.a: Yes — Afrah ERP is a cloud platform, so you and your team always see the same data. Any modern browser works on phone, tablet, or laptop.

items.q: Can I import my existing bookings and clients?
items.a: Absolutely. During onboarding we help you import bookings, clients, and payment history from Excel or your old system.

items.q: Will my whole team be able to use it?
items.a: Yes. You can add unlimited users on the Pro plan, each with their own role: admin, sales, or accountant. Everyone sees what they need, nothing more.

items.q: What payment methods do you support?
items.a: All the ones Egyptian clients actually use: InstaPay, Fawry, Vodafone Cash, bank transfer, cash, and credit card — with proof of payment attached.
Yes — Arabic is the default. The full UI is RTL, and you can switch to English with one click for foreign clients or staff.
Most venues are running their first booking in under 10 minutes. Full onboarding (halls, packages, team) takes about an hour.
